$comment: Pinned third-party tools. Source lives in tools/<name> as a shallow git submodule at the commit below. Policy: pin the newest stable release that is at least 14 days old (supply-chain cooldown). Update with: node bin/hades.mjs tools bump <name> <tag>

rea.role: Reverse engineering of built artefacts and binaries (cybersecurity engineer, software architect)

serena.role: Symbol-level code navigation and editing over MCP (all engineering roles)

ccusage.role: Token and cost reporting from Claude Code session logs (project manager)

semgrep.role: Static application security testing (cybersecurity engineer, pre-deploy gate)

gitleaks.role: Secret scanning (cybersecurity engineer, pre-commit and pre-deploy gates)

trivy.role: Dependency, IaC, container and SBOM scanning (cybersecurity engineer, devops engineer)

playwright-mcp.role: Browser automation over MCP (QA engineer, frontend engineer)

zaproxy.role: Dynamic application security testing of deployed systems (cybersecurity engineer)

aws-agent-toolkit.note: The repository publishes no release tags; pinned to the newest main commit older than the cooldown.
aws-agent-toolkit.role: Official AWS skills, rules and plugin definitions (devops engineer; software architect and cybersecurity engineer on demand)

mcp-proxy-for-aws.role: Local SigV4 proxy that connects the AWS MCP server to Claude Code with a named AWS profile (devops engineer)
